Florida rental review SOP. Document FL-RENTAL-002, version 2.0. Loss state: FL. Product and peril scope: Personal
collision. Benefit: rental reimbursement only where the supplied policy expressly includes it. Effective for loss dates
2024-01-01 through 2026-12-31 inclusive.

This is a new synthetic demonstration version, not an amendment to an actual policy. Select this corpus alone; do not
mix its rules with the legacy v1 corpus. The claim's contractual daily and cumulative limits always apply independently.
This SOP never supplies a missing policy benefit, endorsement, loss date or state.

This is a rental-only processing review. A confirmed towing-only, repair-only, glass-service-only, valuation-only or
commercial downtime-only packet has no rental request: all five rental checks are NOT APPLICABLE, not approved or
satisfied. A policy's rental limit or premium is not a request. Absence of extracted fields or a classifier label alone does
not confirm no request.

Use SHARED-EVIDENCE-002 v2.0 with this SOP. The controlling decision matrix, numeric schedules, exception
conditions and checkbox worksheet are on pages 2-4. They must be read together. A retrieval path that returns only
this cover has insufficient rule evidence; request review.

# RENTAL REIMBURSEMENT - TERMS AND ELIGIBILITY

Form: RNT-FL-P05 State: FL Policy: PRC-A3933393

Vehicle: 2019 Toyota Corolla LE VIN: 5YFEPMAE3KA513905


## R.1 COVERED BENEFIT

For a vehicle with rental reimbursement shown on the declarations, we pay reasonable substitute-vehicle rental charges incurred
because of a covered loss, subject to R.2 through R.5. A vehicle without this coverage has no benefit under this form.


## R.2 WHEN ELIGIBILITY BEGINS

(a) If the covered vehicle cannot safely be driven because of the covered loss, eligibility begins when it becomes disabled. (b) If the
covered vehicle remains safely drivable, eligibility begins when it is actually delivered for covered repairs. A scheduled appointment alone
does not establish delivery.


## R.3 WHEN ELIGIBILITY ENDS

Eligibility ends at the earlier of repair completion or exhaustion of the maximum covered days shown on the declarations. This form
addresses repairable vehicles only; a total-loss case requires separate review.


## R.4 LIMITS AND CHARGES

The base rental charge is limited to the daily amount and maximum days shown on the declarations, as modified by an effective
endorsement. Mandatory rental taxes and surcharges are additional to the base daily limit. Fuel, optional products and rental-vehicle
damage charges are excluded. No separate rental deductible applies.


## R.5 EVIDENCE AND OTHER PAYMENTS

Provide the rental agreement, itemized bill, actual repair-delivery date and repair-completion date. Supporting repair records may be
requested. Do not receive duplicate reimbursement for the same expense. A bill is not proof of payment or insurer authorization.


## R.6 READING THIS FORM

An effective endorsement modifying a specific provision controls that provision; all other terms remain unchanged. The page 2 flowchart
summarizes R.1-R.3 and does not replace the wording above. Missing evidence leaves eligibility unresolved.

Rule Required handling Never do this

E-02 Applicability Confirm actual rental request versus confirmed non-rental packet using invoice identity AND document inventory; preserve unknown/conflict as review No request is NOT APPLICABLE, not satisfied. Missing extraction alone never proves no request
E-03 Evidence and chronology Final return supersedes pickup's return-pending field; actual shop dates remain separate; explicit no prior usage differs from unknown Do not infer actual downtime, zero prior days or insurer approval from completed return
E-04 Tables and checkboxes Read merged table title, column headers, authority row, footnote and checkbox label/state together Do not join routine rate to exception days; unchecked is unanswered
E-05 Entity and charge identity Match claim/insured/agreement; keep rental vehicle distinct; reconcile only rental invoice lines Do not treat tow/repair/glass/valuation/premium as rental or copy values from unrelated tax forms
E-06 Honest output Five ordered checks with outcome, expected, actual, concise reason and exact rule-file citation. Unknowns remain explicit No missing rule text = pass; no fabricated sources; no payment decision
